metadata.question: Does the rainfall in Somalia decrease during March-September 2022 compared to the 1981-2021 average?

data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
somalia = ee.Geometry.Polygon([
    [40.98, 11.99], [51.41, 11.99], [51.41, -1.66], [40.98, -1.66], [40.98, 11.99]
])

# Baseline period (1981-2021 March-September)
baseline_start = '1981-03-01'
baseline_end = '2021-09-30'

# Target period (2022 March-September)
target_start = '2022-03-01'
target_end = '2022-09-30'

# 2. Data Acquisition
chirps = ee.ImageCollection('UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY')

# Get baseline collection
baseline_col = chirps.filterDate(baseline_start, baseline_end) \
                     .filter(ee.Filter.calendarRange(3, 9, 'month')) \
                     .filterBounds(somalia)

# Get target collection  
target_col = chirps.filterDate(target_start, target_end) \
                   .filterBounds(somalia)

# Check for empty collections
if baseline_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No baseline data found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
elif target_col.size().getInfo() == 0:
    print("No target data found.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3. Processing - Calculate mean precipitation
    baseline_mean = baseline_col.mean()
    target_mean = target_col.mean()
    
    # Calculate pixel counts to check for valid data
    baseline_count = baseline_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=somalia,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    target_count = target_mean.reduceRegion(
        reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
        geometry=somalia,
        scale=5000,
        maxPixels=1e9
    ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
    
    if baseline_count == 0 or target_count == 0:
        print(f"Valid pixels - Baseline: {baseline_count}, Target: {target_count}")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        # Calculate mean precipitation values
        baseline_rainfall = baseline_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=somalia,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        target_rainfall = target_mean.reduceRegion(
            reducer=ee.Reducer.mean(),
            geometry=somalia,
            scale=5000,
            maxPixels=1e9
        ).get('precipitation').getInfo()
        
        # 4. Validation & Final Answer
        if baseline_rainfall is None or target_rainfall is None:
            print("<answer>C3</answer>")
        else:
            print(f"Baseline avg: {baseline_rainfall:.2f} mm")
            print(f"2022 period: {target_rainfall:.2f} mm")
            print(f"Difference: {target_rainfall - baseline_rainfall:.2f} mm")
            print(f"Decrease: {target_rainfall < baseline_rainfall}")
            
            if target_rainfall < baseline_rainfall:
                print("<answer>A</answer>")
            else:
                print("<answer>B</answer>")
